oracles.trigger: A provider and a consumer exchange data through S8 Plugin transport.
oracles.observe: The exchanged data, the return value and the visible state.
expected: The provider hands over the documented data.
The consumer reports a failure to the owner.
oracles.failure_message: The seam drops data or reports success after a failure.

oracles.title: Unit 01 behaviors
oracles.trigger: The user operates a unit control on HarmonyOS.
oracles.observe: Control state, screen text, persisted store and service state.
expected: The unit follows the Android baseline.
A failed action keeps the screen usable.
oracles.failure_message: The HarmonyOS screen or store differs from the baseline.
